valueString.value: define "MedicationAdministrations": [MedicationAdministration]
define "Medications": [Medication]
define "EncounterInpatient": [Encounter: "Encounter Inpatient"] union [Encounter: class in {"inpatient encounter", "inpatient acute", "inpatient non-acute", "short stay"}]
define "EncounterObservation": [Encounter: "Observation Services"] union [Encounter: class in {"observation encounter"}]
Qualifying Encounter During Measurement Period

define "Qualifying Encounter During Measurement Period": ( "EncounterInpatient" union "EncounterObservation") QualifyingEncounters where QualifyingEncounters.status in {'in-progress', 'finished', 'triaged'} and QualifyingEncounters.period overlaps "Measurement Period"
Qualifying Location During Measurement Period

define "Qualifying Location During Measurement Period": [Encounter] Encounters where exists( Encounters.location EncounterLocation where Global.GetLocation(EncounterLocation.location).type in "Inpatient, Emergency, and Observation Locations" and EncounterLocation.period overlaps Encounters.period )
Initial Population
SDE Covid or Influenza Medication Administered

define "SDE Covid or Influenza Medication Administered": "MedicationAdministrations" RPSMedAdmin let Meds: GetMedicationCode(RPSMedAdmin.medication) where (Meds in "Anakinra" or Meds in "Bamlanivimab" or Meds in "Baricitinib" or Meds in "Bebtelovimab" or Meds in "Casirivimab" or Meds in "Casirivimab / Imdevimab" or Meds in "COVID19 RxNorm Value Set for Tocilizumab" or Meds in "Etesevimab" or Meds in "Imdevimab" or Meds in "Molnupiravir" or Meds in "Nirmatrelvir / Ritonavir" or Meds in "Oseltamivir" or Meds in "Remdesivir" or Meds in "Sarilumab" or Meds in "Sotrovimab" or Meds in "Tofacitinib") and RPSMedAdmin.status ~ 'completed' and exists("Initial Population") and Global."Normalize Interval"(RPSMedAdmin.effective) during "Measurement Period" return SharedResource.MedicationAdministrationResource(RPSMedAdmin)
define "DiagnosticReports": [DiagnosticReport]
define "Observations": [Observation]
SDE RPS DiagnosticReport Result from Lab

define "SDE RPS DiagnosticReport Result from Lab": from "DiagnosticReports" Reports, "Initial Population" InitialPopulation where (GetObservations(Reports.result).code in "COVID_19 (Tests for SARS_CoV_2 Nucleic Acid)" or GetObservations(Reports.result).code in "COVID_19 (Tests for SARS_CoV_2 Antigen)" or GetObservations(Reports.result).code in "Influenza (Tests for influenza A or B virus Nucleic Acid)" or GetObservations(Reports.result).code in "Influenza (Tests for influenza A or B virus Antigen)" or GetObservations(Reports.result).code in "RSV (Tests for RSV Nucleic Acid)" or GetObservations(Reports.result).code in "RSV (Tests for RSV Antigen)") and Reports.status in {'final'} and exists("Initial Population") and (start of Global."Normalize Interval"(Reports.effective) during "Measurement Period" or Global."Normalize Interval"(Reports.effective) 14 days or less on or before start of InitialPopulation.period) return SharedResource.DiagnosticReportResource(Reports)
SDE Isolation Precautions Implemented

define "SDE Isolation Precautions Implemented": [Procedure: "Transmission Based Precaution Types"] IsolationPrecautions where Global."Normalize Interval"(IsolationPrecautions.performed) during "Measurement Period" and exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.ProcedureResource(IsolationPrecautions)
RPS Observation 1

//Retrieve Observation categories and lab codes valuesets define "RPS Observation 1": ([Observation: "Influenza (Tests for influenza A or B virus Nucleic Acid)"] union [Observation: "Influenza (Tests for influenza A or B virus Antigen)"] union [Observation: "COVID_19 (Tests for SARS_CoV_2 Nucleic Acid)"] union [Observation: "COVID_19 (Tests for SARS_CoV_2 Antigen)"] union [Observation: "RSV (Tests for RSV Nucleic Acid)"] union [Observation: "RSV (Tests for RSV Antigen)"] ) Observations where exists(Observations.category Category where Category ~ "laboratory") and exists("Initial Population")
RPS Observation 2

//further filter by the timing define "RPS Observation 2": from "RPS Observation 1" Observations where exists("Initial Population" InitialPopulation where Global."Normalize Interval"(Observations.effective) 14 days or less on or before start of InitialPopulation.period or Global."Normalize Interval"(GetSpecimen(Observations.specimen).collection.collected) 14 days or less on or before start of InitialPopulation.period) or start of Global."Normalize Interval"(Observations.effective) during "Measurement Period" or Global."Normalize Interval"(GetSpecimen(Observations.specimen).collection.collected) during "Measurement Period"
SDE RPS Specimen
SDE RPSObservation
SDE All ServiceRequests
SDE RPS ServiceRequest

define "SDE RPS ServiceRequest": ([ServiceRequest: "COVID_19 (Tests for SARS_CoV_2 Nucleic Acid)"] union [ServiceRequest: "COVID_19 (Tests for SARS_CoV_2 Antigen)"] union [ServiceRequest: "Influenza (Tests for influenza A or B virus Nucleic Acid)"] union [ServiceRequest: "Influenza (Tests for influenza A or B virus Antigen)"] union [ServiceRequest: "RSV (Tests for RSV Nucleic Acid)"] union [ServiceRequest: "RSV (Tests for RSV Antigen)"] ) ServiceRequests where ServiceRequests.intent ~ 'order' and ServiceRequests.status ~ 'completed' and exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.ServiceRequestResource(ServiceRequests)
SDE All Procedures
SDE Location
define "SDE Location": [Location] Locations where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.LocationResource(Locations)
SDE Encounter Discharge Dispositions

define "SDE Encounter Discharge Dispositions": "Initial Population" DischargeDispositions where DischargeDispositions.hospitalization.dischargeDisposition in "Discharge Disposition" return SharedResource.EncounterResource(DischargeDispositions)
SDE RPS DiagnosticReport

define "SDE RPS DiagnosticReport": from "Initial Population" InitialPopulation, ([DiagnosticReport: "COVID_19 (Tests for SARS_CoV_2 Nucleic Acid)"] union [DiagnosticReport: "COVID_19 (Tests for SARS_CoV_2 Antigen)"] union [DiagnosticReport: "Influenza (Tests for influenza A or B virus Nucleic Acid)"] union [DiagnosticReport: "Influenza (Tests for influenza A or B virus Antigen)"] union [DiagnosticReport: "RSV (Tests for RSV Nucleic Acid)"] union [DiagnosticReport: "RSV (Tests for RSV Antigen)"] ) Reports where exists("Initial Population") and Reports.status in {'final'} and (start of Global."Normalize Interval"(Reports.effective) during "Measurement Period" or Global."Normalize Interval"(Reports.effective) 14 days or less on or before start of InitialPopulation.period) return SharedResource.DiagnosticReportResource(Reports)
define "MedicationRequests": [MedicationRequest]
SDE Covid or Influenza Medication Ordered

define "SDE Covid or Influenza Medication Ordered": "MedicationRequests" RPSMedRequest let Meds: (GetMedicationCode(RPSMedRequest.medication)) where (Meds in "Anakinra" or Meds in "Bamlanivimab" or Meds in "Baricitinib" or Meds in "Bebtelovimab" or Meds in "Casirivimab" or Meds in "Casirivimab / Imdevimab" or Meds in "COVID19 RxNorm Value Set for Tocilizumab" or Meds in "Etesevimab" or Meds in "Imdevimab" or Meds in "Molnupiravir" or Meds in "Nirmatrelvir / Ritonavir" or Meds in "Oseltamivir" or Meds in "Remdesivir" or Meds in "Sarilumab" or Meds in "Sotrovimab" or Meds in "Tofacitinib") //and RPSMedRequest.status ~ 'completed' //This is not needed for the medication ordered and exists("Initial Population") and Global."Normalize Interval"(RPSMedRequest.authoredOn) during "Measurement Period" return SharedResource.MedicationRequestResource(RPSMedRequest)
SDE Minimal Patient
SDE All Observations
SDE Medication

define "SDE Medication": ("SDE Covid or Influenza Medication Ordered" union "SDE Covid or Influenza Medication Administered") MedReqOrAdmin where MedReqOrAdmin.medication is FHIR.Reference return SharedResource.MedicationResource(GetMedicationFrom(MedReqOrAdmin.medication))
